description: Sets room choice for one Hosted property in the selected wedding. The property is identified by id or an exact, unambiguous name; matching ignores case and surrounding spaces. A non-null mode selects couple assignment or guest choice. Null restores the legacy wedding fallback. Other properties retain their settings. Results return the property id, stored override and effective mode. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

property_id.description: Identifier of a property in the selected wedding.

property_name.description: Exact property name, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. Duplicate names require a property identifier.

room_selection_mode.description: Property room choice: couple_assigned means the couple assigns rooms; guest_choice means guests choose available rooms. Null clears the override and follows the legacy wedding setting. A non-null choice requires a Hosted property.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: set_my_property_room_selection
title: Set Property Room Choice
